svg.title: a vector pattern of Columbia Point and Regina Point (from a CC0 photo; colours judged)
svg.desc: Drawn from the rectified face of Columbia Point (photo 3, against the sun): one floor (3.09 m = 61.7 m / 20 levels) by one bay of 4.8 m: red-brown panel 1.2 m, window 1.2 m, cream pier 1.1 m, window 1.2 m, over a cream band at the slab. Widths from the photo with its metric aspect (1.35 to 1.44 from the vanishing points). The colours are judged material colours, not measured: the photo is against the sun. Left out: the recessed balcony row every fourth floor (one bay) and the glazed stair column. Regina Point is its twin and gets the same tile. Licence: CC0 1.0.
